main_text.p: pius, ut ab citius restituar[?] vobis; dum dicit, scitote Fratrem nostrum Timotheum solutum esse &c. Ibidem, μὲν δὲ ἡ γνωρίζων ὑμῖν αὐτῷ πρὸ Πα-ολὴν, ὡς ἡ ἀνάγκη αὐτῷ πολλὰ διδάσκει[?]. Multa etiam alia palàm faciunt illius esse Epistolam, ut & lectio ipsa sequens docebit.

XXXIII. Theophylactus, Archiepiscopus Bulgariæ, undecimo jam sæculo, Græcorum Patrum novissimus, Commentario in Epistolam, acerrimum se receptæ sententiæ defensorem profitetur. In Præfatione, postquam Paulum Hebræis invisum fuisse monuit, imò nec quidem gratiâ valuisse apud conversos Hebræorum, annectit rationes quas ipsum nihilominus ad scribendum impulerunt; easdem sanè cum rationibus Chrysostomi, & aliorum. ὥσπερ οὖν ἐπιχειρεῖν βαπτίζειν, ἀλλ' ὅμως, οὕτω καὶ Ἑβραίοις ἐκ περιουσίας (alij ἐκ περιτομῆς) ἐπιστέλλει. Σφόδρα αὐτῶν σκάνδαλον, ὑπὲρ ὧν ἀναγκαῖα ἢ γενέσθαι ἤυχετο.

page.notes: Running head and page number read from the scan; the page number is printed "93". Doubtful readings: the Greek lines at the top of the page and "restituar" in the first line are uncertain, marked [?]. The Greek in the XXXIII. paragraph is transcribed from the scan and may contain small accent or breathing errors; the ὅμως/ἀλλ' reading is also doubtful. The Greek and italic opening lines are set in italic type. The paragraph starting "XXXIII." is kept as a paragraph, since it opens with a number.
